coder_notes: Single-arm Phase 1 dose escalation of selinexor added to standard RT/temozolomide. Eligibility includes 'astrocytoma, grade IV' without IDH requirement, so cns5_terminology historical. Supportive agents (5-HT3 antagonists, olanzapine, salt tablets, anti-diarrheal) are registered interventions and listed as supportive; the 5-HT3 antagonist is unspecified, and the anti-diarrheal is named loperamide only as an alternative name.
